player_0.content: New plan: I fell into an infinite loop between the Craft room and the Dining room by repeatedly choosing the only available direction (west) without checking if I had already visited those rooms. I failed to track my visited locations or recognize that I was revisiting the same state. Next time, I will maintain a mental list of visited rooms. If a direction leads to a room I have already been in, I will immediately choose a different direction or stop if no new options exist. I will not repeat moves to the same room until I have confirmed all reachable unvisited rooms have been explored.
